sentences.text:
THIS CRIMINAL PETITION IS FILED UNDER SECTION 482 OF CR.P.C.,(528 OF BNSS) PRAYING TO QUASH THE FIRST INFORMATION REPORT DATED 28.06.2024 IN CRIME NO.
71/2024 REGISTERED BY THE (MANGALORE WOMEN P.S)
RESPONDENT NO.1 POLICE FOR OFFENCES PUNISHABLE UNDER SECTION 354 AND 376 OF THE INDIAN PENAL CODE PENDING ON THE FILE OF THE 3RD JMFC COURT AT MANGALURU VIDE ANNEXURE-A.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR FINAL HEARING, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA

Learned counsel for the petitioner has moved a memo seeking permission to withdraw the petition with liberty to file a fresh petition challenging the charge sheet filed by the police.
2.

The memo reads as follows:
"MEMO 1. Petitioner has filed the above petition seeking for quashing of the FIR.
This Hon'ble Court vide order dated 30.09.2024 stayed all further proceedings till the appearance of the complainant.
Pursuant to this, NC: 2024:KHC:51054 the Respondent No.2 police has filed charge sheet before the Trial Court.

2. WHEREFORE, its is humbly prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to take this memo on record and permit the petitioner to withdraw the above petition with liberty to file a fresh petition challenging the charge sheet and further proceedings, in the interest of justice and equity."
